item.title: SAFETY/NEW JERSEY INTRACOASTAL WATERWAY/DREDGING/SEC SDB BNM 0285-26
item.description:
1.ALL MARINERS PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT MAINTENANCE DREDGING OF THE NEW JERSEY INTRACOASTAL WATERWAY NEAR GREAT BAY, NJ WILL CONTINUE UNTIL DECEMBER 30, 2026. THE DREDGE FULLERTON STARTS UP 500' PAST MARKER #144 AND ROUGHLY 500' PAST MARKER #136N. DREDGING IS ALSO BEING COMPLETED BETWEEN MARKERS #144, #141, AND #138, #136. DREDGING IS CONDUCTED 24 HOURS A DAY IN THREE 8-HOUR SHIFTS, MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY. THE DREDGE FULLERTON WILL MONITOR VHF RADIO CHANNELS 13 AND 16. MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO TRANSIT THE AREA WITH CAUTION.
CANCEL AT//140100Z NOV 26//

BT

item.title: SAFETY/PA – DELAWARE RIVER COMMODORE BARRY BRIDGE/ATON/SEC SDB BNM 0277-26
item.description:
1. ALL MARINERS BE ADVISED OF BARGE OPERATIONS BEING CONDUCTED ON THE DELAWARE RIVER IN THE VICINITY OF THE COMMODORE BARRY BRIDGE AT POSITION 39°49.068’N 75°23.334’W AND 39°49.728’N 75°22.332’W. ALL MARINERS ARE REQUESTED TO TRANSIT AT THE SLOWEST SAFE SPEED TO MAINTAIN NAVIGATION AND MINIMIZE WAKE.
CANCEL AT//102200Z NOV 26//
